name: s81lk_kp4_deca
structural_change: S81-KP4 10-17: FRONT hard sub-tile of the KP4 decoder cluster ot_s81_kp4_dec (the one-tile streaming decoder s81lk_kp4_dec measured at its CTS gate 11,098 sinks in 367.2 x 345.6 um: TT insertion 383-513 ps, spread 130 ps, setup -121 ps (align popcount -> FSM -> 32-bit counter from the pin) -- split into two ~260 um tiles with their own roots, registered seam). Alignment FSM on registered am_ok / p_v; syndromes on the arriving stream (fixed-offset one-hot select x4 copies, window matrix registered a cycle ahead); 3 RiBM key-equation units (one GF multiply + XOR a cycle, PE-group control copies); 64 x 546 received-word SRAM delay line u_dmem on the 43.2 lattice (pins on its W / E edges; std cells in one band around it). West face = PMA side (p_d full face); east face = the seam to s81lk_kp4_decb (d_q 544 + k_* 320, pin positions identical to decb's west face); clk / rst_n S centre. Regional synchronous reset, no datapath reset. Exact vs rs544.py through the cluster (KP4 bench base PASS 140 out / 122 exact / 17 flagged / 0 miscorrected; front mutant MUT 3 FAIL).

job.purpose: S81 link KP4 decoder FRONT sub-tile (align, syndromes, 3 RiBM, received-word SRAM delay) of the cluster ot_s81_kp4_dec, 10-17. Bench = KP4 base through the cluster (exact vs rs544.py) and the front-tile mutant MUT 3.
